description: This file defines a Visual Studio Code extension component for managing a status bar item related to Ghost AI features, including display logic, tooltip generation, and state updates.

classes.name: GhostStatusBar
classes.description: A class managing a VSCode status bar item for Ghost AI status, including initialization, rendering, and error states.

methods.name: getSupportedProviderDisplayNames
methods.description: Returns display names for supported autocomplete providers based on provider models.

methods.name: constructor
methods.description: Initializes the GhostStatusBar with given properties and sets up the status bar item.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Sets initial text and tooltip for the status bar and shows it.

methods.name: createMarkdownTooltip
methods.description: Creates a trusted MarkdownString for tooltips.

methods.name: updateVisible
methods.description: Shows or hides the status bar based on the enabled property.

methods.name: dispose
methods.description: Disposes of the status bar item.

methods.name: humanFormatSessionCost
methods.description: Formats the session cost into a human-readable string.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Updates the component's properties and re-renders accordingly.

methods.name: formatTime
methods.description: Formats a timestamp into a locale time string.

methods.name: renderDefault
methods.description: Renders the default status bar text and tooltip.

methods.name: render
methods.description: Determines which render method to call based on current state.

methods.name: renderNoCreditsError
methods.description: Displays a warning when there are no credits.

methods.name: renderNoUsableProviderError
methods.description: Displays a warning when no usable provider is available.
